api.branchState: TechBranchState(branch: branch, unlocked: unlocked, researchLevel: level, choices: choices): tiers, perks in order, and optionAt(l) for l = 1 to 5
api.effects: TechEffects(tech, halved: halved) with tech = {branch: [level, choices]} for the unlocked branches, the others locked: see the README for the getter behind each key of out
api.researchCost: TechCostCalculator.researchCost(branch, level, opened: opened); nothing outside levels 1 to 5
api.unlockCost: TechCostCalculator.unlockCost(branch, opened: opened); percent is TechCostCalculator.costPercent(opened)
